dcterms:description: A publicly available reference database for pulmonary nodules containing CT scans used for the LUNA16 challenge, specifically aimed at automatic detection of nodules in volumetric CT images.
dcterms:title: LUng Nodule Analysis 2016 (LUNA16) Challenge

dcterms:creator: S.G. Armato
G. McLennan
L. Bidaut
dcterms:description: A completed reference database of lung nodules on CT scans, which serves as a foundational dataset for various studies and challenges in pulmonary nodule detection.
dcterms:title: Lung Image Database Consortium (LIDC) and Image Database Resource Initiative (IDRI)
